subject: Culture
title: Space Burials
description: A fast breakdown of Space Burials for builders.

hook.text: Gene Roddenberry, creator of Star Trek, had his ashes launched into space in 1997. Tickets now start at $2,500.

buildup.text: Companies like Celestis and Elysium Space offer to send cremated remains into orbit, to the moon, or into deep space.

discovery.text: Clyde Tombaugh, who found Pluto, has ashes aboard New Horizons—the farthest human remains from Earth.

twist.text: Native Hawaiians protested lunar burials on Mauna Kea's telescopes. Sacred space on Earth extends to sacred space above.

climax.text: Space burial turns the cosmos into a cemetery. It extends humanity's need to be remembered beyond the planet itself.

punchline.text: We send our dead to the stars because we've always looked up.

quiz.question: Whose ashes are aboard the New Horizons spacecraft?
